استأجروا (form X)
# اِسْتَأْجَرُوا (istaʔjarū) /is.taʔ.d͡ʒa.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَأْجَرَ (istaʔjara)
# اِسْتَأْجِرُوا (istaʔjirū) /is.taʔ.d͡ʒi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَأْجَرَ (istaʔjara)
